acceptance: (a) Tests: keep-branch mode removes a clean worktree and leaves refs/heads/<branch> at the expected head; it refuses a dirty worktree, one with commits not on origin, a head mismatch and a locked worktree; default mode is unchanged. Or (b) the worktree doc states the plain-git procedure with its preconditions.
The owner's choice is recorded here; merged through the BenchBox close-out.
context:
2026-11-17 owner decision: option (a). Add a keep-branch mode to make worktree-finish with the same safety checks (clean tree, commits on origin, expected head, never a locked worktree) and no merged-PR requirement.

Fixed by https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox/pull/4292, merged as f3990481be. `make worktree-finish ... KEEP_BRANCH=1` (`--keep-branch`) removes the worktree and keeps the local and remote branch. Used on 2026-11-19 to retire 9 clean worktrees; afterwards each local branch and its origin branch existed at the same commit.
description:
Gap. make worktree-finish (scripts/worktree_finish.py) always deletes the local branch (`git update-ref -d refs/heads/<branch>`) and acts only when the branch's PR is merged. Retiring a clean worktree whose branch should be kept (no PR yet, a closed PR, or work the owner may resume) therefore has no supported path. On 2026-11-14, removing 28 clean pre-tractable worktrees with their branches kept had to fall back to plain `git worktree remove`, bypassing the tool's provenance and expected-head checks. Related: worktree-reap-leaves-malformed-and-closed-pr-worktrees-20261112 (the reaper cannot remove some worktrees at all).

Decision gate (owner): either (a) add a keep-branch mode to worktree-finish (for example KEEP_BRANCH=1) that removes only the worktree, still requires a clean tree, commits on origin and the expected head, and needs no merged PR, or (b) document plain `git worktree remove` (never --force) as the supported way to retire a clean unmerged worktree. Recommendation: (a), because it keeps the safety checks in one place.

Guardrails:
- Never remove a worktree with uncommitted changes or commits not on origin.
- The default behaviour of worktree-finish for merged PRs is unchanged.
- A locked worktree is never unlocked or removed by the tool.
